clips.caption:
Comment "BRAIN" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says one trait every wealthy person has costs nothing to practice tonight: initiative. Taking action before anyone asks.

His example is almost insulting because it's so familiar. The trash can is overflowing. You keep shoving it down instead of taking the bag out. Someone finally has to ask, and you get annoyed: 'I hate being told what to do.'

That reaction is the whole difference. Winners take the bag out before anyone has to ask. Everyone else waits to be told, then resents being told.

Are you the one who notices, or the one who waits?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #successhabits #wealthmindset #selfimprovement #yourwishisyourcommand
clips.send: A roommate tired of nagging sends this to the roommate who waits to be told: proof that waiting to be asked is the exact mindset that keeps people broke. Emotion: a little embarrassment, a little recognition.

Comment "MONEY" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau describes walking down Rodeo Drive: Ferraris, Lamborghinis, a $35,000 purse in a window, people in their twenties driving Rolls Royces paid for in cash.

Then the houses. $15 million, $20 million, $25 million - the kind of neighborhood where a $5 million home is the cheap one. You look at one and wonder who actually lives there.

The answer, one time: a 28-year-old woman who started her own business, from Nebraska. She paid cash for the $20 million house.

If she can do it, why can't you? Why not right now?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #milliondollarhouse #successstory #moneymindset #yourwishisyourcommand
clips.send: A friend scrolling real-estate listings for fun sends this to the friend who thinks a $20 million house only happens to people born into it: proof it doesn't. Emotion: awe and a jolt of possibility.
